text:
nina.r: Quick follow-up after the postmortem: we need a short public status blurb, a customer-facing 72h summary, and a policy for who can receive the full RCA. Who owns what?

jon: I can draft the public blurb. Keep it one short paragraph + promise of a detailed follow-up.

tara: I'll build the 72h summary skeleton (timeline, metrics, mitigations, recurrence notes).

legal: I'll provide the redaction rules. Anything with customer IDs or internal hostnames must be removed unless there's an NDA.

support-lead: I'll produce the impacted-customer list and assign outreach owners.

nina.r: Let's lock owners and deadlines now. Post AIs and accept them in-thread.

```
AI-311: Jon 97 Draft public status blurb by Wed 10:00 UTC and post to Statuspage draft.
AI-312: Tara 97 Drop 72h customer summary skeleton to ticket by Thu 12:00 UTC (include recurrence mitigation proposal).
AI-313: Legal 97 Publish redaction checklist and approval flow by Thu 16:00 UTC.
AI-314: Support-Lead 97 Share impacted customer list + outreach owners by Wed 18:00 UTC.
AI-315: Nina.R 97 Add AIs to incident PM-501 and confirm final approver for public copy.
```

support-lead: Accept AI-314. I'll tag owners by this afternoon.

jon: Draft blurb: "We experienced a short outage affecting some API requests between 03:10	6:05 UTC due to a database failover. Normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after rerouting. We apologize for the impact and will publish a detailed summary within 72 hours."

tara: Good start. For the 72h note I'll include a short section on recurring failovers and a proposal for automated backoff in the runbook.

legal: Confirmed on redactions. We'll remove hostnames, internal IPs, and customer-identifiable logs. Full RCA available on request with NDA where required.

ops-bot: Reminder: add AI-311..AI-315 to PM-501 with due dates.

nina.r: Thanks. If anyone can't meet their ETA, flag here so we can reassign. I'll check PM-501 tomorrow morning and close the loop.

jon: Posting draft now.

support-lead: Owners tagged.

tara: Starting 72h draft.
